spans.s:
(ऋ) धोरृ r. 1st cl. (धोरति)
To move well, to be quick or alert, or to have good paces.

n. (-णं)
1 A vehicle in general, any means of conveyance, as a horse, an elephant, a car, &c.
2 A horse's trot.
3 Going well or quickly.
E.
धोर to move well or quickly, affix ल्युट्.

f. (-णिः)
Tradition.
E.
धोर to proceed, affix अनि.

n. (-तं)
A horse's trot.
E.
धोर to go well, affix क्त; also with कन् added, धोरितक n. (-कं) and with अण् again added, धौरितक.
